statement: The nine 0.5 WASI service test files (test/service/h1-h5, q2-q5) are classified resource class external-toolchain, like their siblings service-cell-worker-modes and service-cell-bridge-roundtrip, under the classification owner's existing rule (test/shards/resource-external-toolchain.txt: tests that drive the real WASM toolchain or start real component Cells run serially, jobs=1, because one such test consumes several cores). Measured cause: at jobs=4 pinned to two cores, 3 of 4 (h2, h3, q4) fail with STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS; the hosted runner (run 41431327759) failed h1-h5 and q2-q4, and q5 passed at 113 s. This is a resource classification correction consistent with the existing rule, not a bound change; it does not close the R12 product defect (kill-and-redo of the per-start transpile under load), which is owned by quest wasi-component-startup-budget.

constraints.statement: No src change, no test assertion change, no timeout change; only resource-class membership with measured real/user numbers, and the regenerated manifest.
Does not close the R12 defect owned by wasi-component-startup-budget; recorded in the quest and CHANGELOG.
